Would you like to make a meaningful contribution to animal health while developing your own skills in a dynamic and varied work environment? Then the Operator position at MSD Animal Health in Boxmeer could be the perfect opportunity for you. At MSD, you will work with a variety of production processes, giving you the opportunity to discover where your interests and strengths lie and specialize in the process that suits you best. Wie zoeken we? You have a good working knowledge of either Dutch or English, both verbally and in writing. You are available to work 32 or 40 hours per week, either in a day shift or in a two-shift schedule. You live within approximately 45 km of Boxmeer. MSD Animal Health is also easily accessible by public transport. Wat bieden wij je? A competitive gross monthly salary ranging from €2,600 to €3,200, depending on experience and qualifications. A stable, long-term opportunity within a friendly, innovative, and forward-thinking organization. A travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer to help cover your commuting expenses. Access to a wide range of training opportunities and possibilities to develop your skills and grow professionally within the organization. Functieomschrijving As an Operator, you play a key role in keeping our production processes running smoothly. At MSD, we offer a range of Operator positions, each with its own area of expertise. Whether you are operating machinery, working in processing, or taking care of packaging, your work directly contributes to the quality, reliability, and success of our products. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure an efficient production schedule, high-quality output, and a smooth production flow. In this way, you make a meaningful contribution every day to improving the health and well-being of animals around the world. What will you do? Identify, document, and follow up on deviations in the production process Provide support to different departments whenever needed Carry out

preparation and completion activities according to the production schedule Create clear work instructions and production procedures Take an active role in continuously improving working methods and processes Ready to take on this varied and rewarding challenge? Apply today and become part of our team!

The Extron AV Programmer will be responsible for assisting customers with the installation and operation of a wide range of Extron A/V control products 
Extron control hardware and PC software are used to manage A/V devices through various interfaces such as serial (RS) and network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, SSH. These A/V systems include both Extron and third-party equipment such as switchers, projectors, displays, and lighting systems. 
A strong background in other control systems - such as AMX, Crestron, or QSC - is essential, along with solid experience in Python programming (or similar). The ideal candidate will demonstrate a deep understanding of integrated A/V environments and be capable of adapting to diverse technical challenges. We are looking for someone based in the BENELUX or DACH area that speaks fluent English. 
Main Responsibilities 
Technical Support & Control Applications - Provide remote and potentially on-site support for Extron AV control systems, assisting with configuration, and troubleshooting. - Diagnose issues related to control software, AV hardware communication (RS, TCP/IP), and third-party device integration. - Guide customers through system setup and resolve anomalies in software or hardware operation. - Provide advanced training for customers-programmers, online or in Extron's facilities, on Extron control solutions. 
Sales & Feedback - Provide feedback to the Control Manager when a case needs escalation. - Inform product improvement needs to the Product&Development team based on field experience and tender requirements. - Maintain awareness of certifications and specifications (medical, military, environmental) relevant to AV control systems. - Report technical issues using internal tools.

"An empty fridge doesn't make anyone happy, right?" As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you make sure customers get their favorite snacks, breakfast and groceries delivered right to their door. On top of that, you’ll score an all-in hourly wage of €18.83. Ka-chinggg!

With you behind the wheel, every delivery becomes a party! And you get paid well for it  too. With flexible working hours, almost anything is possible.

Want to know more? Read on to check out the rest of the job opening!

- A great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks

As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you deliver groceries right to the customer's front door. You are physically fit and have no problem lifting crates. You can also easily step in and out of the delivery van on a regular basis.

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You have your own transportation to get to Heyderweg 2-6 in Leiden.
- You hold a valid category B driver's license.

What will you do
From well-known cities to tiny villages you didn't even know existed: that is what awaits you as an Albert Heijn delivery driver. Every day is different. Some days your workday runs smoothly, and other days you run into obstacles—like an apartment building without an elevator or a house number that's nowhere to be found. You’ll experience it all.

Fortunately, you are well-prepared during your onboarding period and you know how to keep a cool head! There are also plenty of opportunities to grow. For instance, you can quickly start working as a buddy, guiding and training new employees. Or you can become a plusser, making sure every driver hits the road fully equipped with all the essentials.
